column1: # CI targets that differ from the default: every tests/<category>/<entry>/test_*.py file is one target (one pytest
# process) on 1 GPU. Columns (tab-separated): path, GPUs, command. path = an entry (the row applies to each of its
# test files, or, with a command, the entry runs as that one target) or one test file (tests/<path>). The command
# runs from the repository root inside tools/enroot_test.sh, through bash -c; empty = `python3 -m pytest tests/<path> -q`.
# Multi-GPU tests skip themselves when fewer GPUs are visible; the rows below give them their GPUs.
# GPUs = skip leaves the path out of CI (the third column says why).
# GPUs = compile: a compile test in compile-only mode (tests/compile_only.py); up to 8 share one card (ci.py).
# precompile (4th column): `same` = the target's own command, or a command (a multi-rank test: the warm-up its
# ranks run), run first in compile-only mode on the shared card in the target's tree; the target then starts warm.
# Its exit code is not checked (tests fail in compile-only mode). For targets whose time is mostly compile.
# No pytest-xdist `-n` in a target's command: its workers would share the target's card, and each card runs one
# target alone (ci.py). A precompile command may use `-n`: it runs on the shared compile card, which runs only
# compile-only work, and FlyDSL compiles in parallel only in separate processes (it holds the GIL).
